Weekend with family at Chicken Society restaurant
May 2024 • Family
First time coming to Chicken Society restaurant to dine with family on the occasion of the holiday on April 30. May 1.
Plus mark:
- Clean and spacious space
- Food and drinks are rich, diverse and delicious. Especially the dipping set for chicken rice with 3 types of chicken: Hainanese steamed chicken, honey grilled chicken and crispy fried chicken. Besides, dishes such as chicken pho, beef pho, and fish cakes are extremely excellent. The quantity of food is large, the taste is especially delicious, and the flavor is completely different from other places.
- Polite staff, positive attitude, professional demeanor.
- There is a playroom for children
- Fully equipped with common and modern facilities and equipment
Minus point: the restaurant has almost no minus points worth reviewing.
=> Thank you to the restaurant staff (about 3-4 people per shift) for always being cheerful and supporting my family in the friendliest way. Especially Quan and Hien, who made the drinks, set up the seating and planned the menu.
Will definitely come back

The food and drinks are amazing. Attractive.
May 2024 • Family
Super delicious honey-grilled chicken thighs with a variety of options for starches and green vegetables for the same chicken portion.
Accompanying that is a diverse drink menu. I really like drinking Daily vitamin water including: Red beets, oranges, apples, carrots which are very good for health
Besides, the restaurant also has la Vong fish cakes, which are already cooked, you just need to sit down and eat without having to stir on the gas stove or induction stove like some other restaurants.
Thank you Quan for your food advice and quick service during our dinner. Will recommend all my acquaintances and friends to come here..!

Enjoyable experience at the restaurant
May 2024 • Family
The restaurant is located deep in the lobby of Fraser suites Hanoi, so when you intend to dine here. You should contact in advance so the staff can guide you through the entrance.
The plus point of the restaurant is its cleanliness and spaciousness.
In the past, when I came here, I often ordered chicken dishes/portions for each person. Now there is Chicken Rice (699,000/1 dish) enough for 4-6 adults to choose from a full menu of chicken rice: Honey grilled chicken, crispy fried chicken, Hainanese steamed chicken, Crispy fried chicken cakes cheese, Fried chicken and mushroom spring rolls, Chicken salad, Salt roasted chicken wings / Fried fish sauce.
Thank you, Quan, for your advice on how to cook chicken and take care of your family throughout the meal, even the smallest thing. Will recommend everyone to come here.
